name: Chloroform
summary: A naturally occurring organic compound once used as an anaesthetic. It has practically disappeared in this usage due to numerous harmful effects including danger of sudden death through cardiac arrhythmia. It been implicated in numerous murders. The drug is unsafe.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Accidental splashing into the eyes has caused irritation. Prolonged dermal exposure can result in the development of sores as a result of defatting. Elimination is primarily through the lungs as chloroform and carbon dioxide; less than 1% is excreted in the urine.

uses.text: Chloroform was once used as an inhalational anesthetic between the 19th century and the first half of the 20th century.
uses.recreational: In the 1910s in England, a famous set of English aristocrats and intellectuals called The Coterie were known to use chloroform recreationally, often at extravagant parties. Margot Asquith, whose stepson Raymond Asquith was a member, recorded Lady Diana Cooper as having left a dinner party in a taxi to fetch chloroform from the chemist.

summaryZh: 氯仿（英語：chloroform）俗稱哥羅芳，化學式CHCl3，分子量119.38。「氯仿」一名為英文名的音譯兼意譯；「哥羅芳」為音譯。氯仿在常溫下為無色、有氣味的液體，是生產聚四氟乙烯的原料；也曾用作製冷劑，現已被淘汰。

sideEffects.en: It causes dizziness, nausea, confusion and loss of consciousness. It can cause sudden death from heart rhythm problems, even without warning signs, and it damages the liver and kidneys. It irritates the skin and eyes.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成頭暈、噁心、意識混亂與失去意識。它可能在毫無預兆下因心律不整造成猝死，並會損害肝臟與腎臟。它也會刺激皮膚與眼睛。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成头晕、恶心、意识混乱与失去意识。它可能在毫无预兆下因心律不整造成猝死，并会损害肝脏与肾脏。它也会刺激皮肤与眼睛。

fact.en: The Scottish doctor James Young Simpson first used chloroform as an anaesthetic in 1847, and Queen Victoria was given it during the birth of Prince Leopold in 1853, which made it fashionable for childbirth.
fact.zh: 蘇格蘭醫師詹姆斯·楊·辛普森在 1847 年首次把氯仿用於麻醉。1853 年維多利亞女王生產利奧波德王子時也使用了氯仿，讓它在分娩時流行起來。
fact.zhHans: 苏格兰医师詹姆斯·杨·辛普森在 1847 年首次把氯仿用于麻醉。1853 年维多利亚女王生产利奥波德王子时也使用了氯仿，让它在分娩时流行起来。
